about.title: About 2022 Tin of the Pharaoh's Gods
paragraphs: 2022 Tin of the Pharaoh's Gods is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG tin released on 14 September 2022, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 272 cards, and with the 2 other rarities there are 274 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 272 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 274, adding the 2 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
